name: A Donation of Wool
summary: Thunder Bluff seeks wool cloth, and you can earn its full recognition by giving sixty pieces. Other donors are expected to bring enough supplies to support the drive.

sections.title: A Cloth Donation
sections.body: Thunder Bluff is gathering wool cloth. Give sixty pieces to earn full recognition for your generosity. Other donors in the realm are expected to bring enough to support the drive.

faq.q: What does Thunder Bluff want donated?
faq.answer: Thunder Bluff is accepting wool cloth donations.

faq.q: How much wool cloth should I give?
faq.answer: Give sixty pieces of wool cloth to earn full recognition from Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: Your gift of sixty pieces of wool cloth earns full recognition from Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why is Thunder Bluff collecting wool?
faq.answer: Thunder Bluff expects other donors in the realm to provide enough wool cloth to support the donation drive.
